style.scope: 已展示的校准版概念图：切面海岸、白盔人物、奶油石材、胡桃木和低光泽铜件

layout.scope: 中央交易池连接档案室、清算室和连通回廊；取票、送单、调仓与历史重演的空间方向

reviewViews: E01 entrance and connected hall layout, day/night
E02 player ticket/slider contact at dealing station, day/night
E03 archive, gallery and two safe exits
E04 clearing-machine interaction and return route
failureConditions: Only more decorative computers, no embodied actions
Character/material style drifts into photographic miniature
Night lights do not illuminate the floor, player and contact surfaces
Play requires repetitive next-day buttons or reading a large dashboard
Architecture requires permanent heavy reflections, lights or polling

generation.dayNightStatus: Matching-camera day and midnight edits derived from the approved concept. Illumination implementation references, not separate user acceptance or engine renders.

runtimeEvidence.note: Primary reviewed actual same-camera day/night renders, a complete keyboard-played historical round, replay, and bidirectional production entrance traversal. Generated images remain reference material; user acceptance of the implemented scene is pending.

nightScope: 保持已批准建筑和布局的日夜照明实施参考，未声称用户已独立验收运行画面。
